who: Structural engineer (rule-set review, Part 9 prescriptive + Part 4 trigger logic)

confidence: Medium (rates sourced; hours are our estimate)
directory: EGBC Registrant Directory: https://tools.egbc.ca/Registrant-Directory/Individual-Registrants (firms: https://tools.egbc.ca/Registrant-Directory/Firms)
